prompt: For 2-methylcyclohexanone, LDA at −78 °C gives which enolate?

options.label: The kinetic enolate — deprotonated at the less-substituted α-carbon.
The thermodynamic enolate — deprotonated at the more-substituted α-carbon.

explanation: LDA is bulky and non-equilibrating at −78 °C; it removes the more accessible (less hindered) α-H, giving the less-substituted (kinetic) enolate.
